title.en: An Act to Exempt All Cases of Summary Settlement of Estates of Deceased Persons and Guardianship Proceedings in Which the Gross Value of the Estate Involved Do Not Exceed three Hundred Pesos, From the Payment of Filing Fees and Other Expenses.

text.en:
All cases of summary settlement of estates of deceased persons and guardianship proceedings in
which the gross value of the estate.involved do.not exceed three hundred pesos, shall be exempt from the
payment of filing fees and other expenses.

This Act shall take .effect on its approval.
Approved, May 22, 1939.
